comment: Considered minoring in journalism after his class. Super interesting and he cares a lot about people understanding what they are learning. News quizzes every week which is the hardest part but not if you keep up to date with everything and he curves them.
Prof Mufti is a super great person and you can tell he really cares. Workload varies. Some weeks you have a ton and some weeks you have none. News quizzes were the hardest part of Jour 100

He is a nice guy and very passionate about his work, but his class was difficult in unnecessary ways--he would make us read lots of news outlets daily for pop quizzes that were sometimes on very niche topics. I enjoyed some of the assignments we did such as making our video, but overall the class was just eh. Would take him if I was journ. major

I would definitely take this class if you're looking to major in journalism, but I wouldn't take it as a gen ed. It's unnecessarily time-consuming, you'll have daily homework over every weekend and holiday, and Shahan tends to go off on tangents in class. He's a great guy and has a decent sense of humor, but I didn't get much out of the course.
Professor Mufti is a GREAT professor. He is super interesting and funny and he really does enjoy what he does. Make sure to participate in class and study for his pop news quizzes.

He is somewhat irrational and definitely an easy B but tough A. A+'s are non existent . Does a lot of talking and it is hard to follow his lectures, but do what is asked of you and the class is interesting and easy. Textbook reading is unnecessary and you can get away with doing minimal reading.
Really makes you work for your grade, but is more than willing to meet with you to help you do better. He is very fair and very respectable, but you do have to try hard for a good grade.

He was really eager to hear everyones' opinions, and he was very engaging. He made the class very interesting, and was always willing to help, but sometimes hard to reach over email. He grades kind of hard, but he's always there to make you understand how to do better, he wants to see you succeed. Don't miss class or skip the readings.

Mufti is strange. His expectations for the class are totally unreasonable and his weekly news quizzes are a pain. His lectures are boring, but you only get two absences, so make them count. Overall, a pretty easy grader, but your grade will be up in the air until the very end, which gives me anxiety. Look elsewhere for News Media and Society.

Very down to earth and considerate person. He's extremely helpful and takes the time to edit ALL of your work. Not an easy grader though, don't expect an A for your first couple of pieces. But he gives opportunities for extra credit and tries to help as much as possible.
